detail.longDescription: The age of software plugins is coming to an end. Thanks # AI ! https:// levelup.gitconnected.com/ai-is -killing-the-software-plugins-0349f1324b44 Why pay for someone else's plugin when you can ask AI to code it for you, and keep it forever?
